scope: Preserve V8U through V9F, acquire only the small Fig1 geometry image, test the Zenodo supplementary ZIP endpoint with safe streamed HTTP Range requests, retrieve only the end record and central directory under hard byte caps, and inventory exact paths for P4V035 and P6V035. Abort before reading a response body if partial content is not honored. Do not download the full ZIP, extract measurement payloads, fit material laws, run a solver or perform impact work.

evidence_policy.observed_fact: A byte count, hash, HTTP header or ZIP-directory field read directly from the public Zenodo source.
evidence_policy.local_archive_claim: No local WTC archive claim is introduced and the source archive is not rescanned.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: The predeclared byte ceilings, target-name rules and permitted-use classifications.
evidence_policy.derived_result: A deterministic central-directory inventory and exact target-path match; not a material or physical result.
evidence_policy.unknown: The contents, units and quality of unacquired measurement payloads and their applicability to any constitutive model.

transcription.units: mm according to the Zenodo record description

selective_payload_candidates.purpose: Exact central-directory-derived candidate list for a separately predeclared V9H selective payload extraction.

P6V035_DIC.reason: The quasi-static force-displacement file is the minimal comparator; the large DIC series is deferred pending signal inspection.

deferred.microhardness_and_EBSD: Outside the first mechanical-signal reduction and not selected.

interpretation: V9G validates a bounded remote ZIP-index audit only. Zenodo honored HTTP Range requests; 366686 bytes were read and the central directory exposes 60 P4V035 plus 881 P6V035 file entries. Their exact paths, sizes and CRC32 values can now support a separately predeclared selective-download iteration. The 955 MB ZIP and all measurement payloads remain undownloaded. Fig1 confirms several millimetre-scale dimensions but is incomplete for a constitutive mesh. No material law, WTC or CF6 property, solver, rupture or facade impact is authorized.

runtime.software: Python standard-library HTTP client plus bounded binary ZIP central-directory parser
